topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: Another day, another curveball. This time, it's a neighbor with a fence on his mind. Seems he's got designs on his property line, wants to make sure his affairs are his and his alone. I listen, nod, but my mind’s on the tracks of what this really means. Boundaries shift when fences go up; friendships can thin like the rain on these streets. I figure there's more to this story, a shadow behind the light. Folks don’t just decide they need a fence, not in our neck of the woods. I’m betting there’s a story, and it’s not just about keeping the kids in or the neighbor's dog out. I’ll be keeping an eye on the hardware store deliveries, see if I can put a finger on what’s really going down.
